name: Catch Me Wooo!
storyline:
It was just another chill day in "Vertigo Hill"—until the servers literally merged. The portal between the spirit world and the human realm glitched wide open, and ghosts who missed our world spawned in to mess around. The only problem? They went full goblin mode and caused way too much paranormal chaos.

The clueless locals, who never believed in the ghost lore anyway, totally panicked and rage-quit the town. But Mr. Wooo? The quirky local mechanic and hardcore ghost nerd everyone called crazy? He’d been theory-crafting this exact crossover event his whole life.

It was time to lock in. He booted up the "Wooo Protocol" and deployed his ultimate squad of ghost-hunting "Wooo-bots". Now, it’s up to his custom mechs to catch the spirits, clear the aggro, and protect Vertigo Hill once again!
summary: Catch Me Wooo! is a cooperative ghost-busting party game for up to four players. Teams work together to clear haunted environments of mischievous spirits, coordinating tasks like tracking entities, tethering them with Spirit Guns, and physically dragging them to a Soul Altar to send them back where they came from. Levels feature varying room layouts and static hazards that complicate team coordination and the core tug-of-war capture mechanics, which require players to synchronize their movements and combine their pulling strength. The game utilizes gadgets such as Baseball Bat to uncover hidden targets and supports online multiplayer alongside local co-op.
